summary: Fed held rates steady at 3.5-3.75% on April 29, 2026 (Powell's final meeting as chair). Most dissents since Oct 1992 (4 dissenters). Median SEP projects 1 rate cut in 2026. Elevated inflation partly due to Middle East energy price spike. High uncertainty about outlook.
